title: WHO: Heat and health
keywords: heat health hydration water shade cooling hot weather prevention
text: High temperatures can affect health. Reduce exposure to excessive heat, keep living spaces cool where possible, and follow local public-health guidance. Seek professional help for suspected heat-related illness.

title: CDC/NIOSH: Heat stress
keywords: workers outdoor work rest shade water heat stress workplace
text: For workers exposed to heat, preventive measures include access to drinking water, rest breaks, shade or cooler areas, training, and gradual acclimatization. Employers should assess workplace conditions.

title: WMO: Extreme heat
keywords: heatwave warning forecast temperature humidity climate extreme heat
text: Extreme heat is a weather and public-health hazard. Monitor official meteorological warnings and local authorities for location-specific forecasts and alerts.
